title: Installing the NotifyHub web SDK
text: Your website must run on HTTPS, because browsers only allow web push on secure pages. You need the Admin or Owner role in NotifyHub to see the installation code.

title: Installing the NotifyHub web SDK
text: Go to Settings > Website and copy the script tag. Paste it into the <head> of every page, before the closing </head> tag. Then download the file nh-sw.js and upload it to the root folder of your domain.

title: Installing the NotifyHub web SDK
text: Open Settings > Website > Integration status. After you install the script, the status turns green within 10 minutes of the first visit to your site. If it stays grey after 10 minutes, clear the page cache and visit the site again.

title: Service worker and the subscription prompt
text: The service worker file nh-sw.js must be served from the root of the same domain as your website, for example https://example.com/nh-sw.js. A file on a subdomain or a CDN will not work, because the browser limits a service worker to its own origin.

title: Service worker and the subscription prompt
text: By default NotifyHub shows a soft prompt after a visitor's second page view. You can change this in Settings > Prompt: show it immediately, after a delay in seconds, or after a number of page views. The native browser prompt only appears after the visitor clicks Allow on the soft prompt.

title: Service worker and the subscription prompt
text: On iOS and iPadOS 16.4 or later, web push works only after the visitor adds your site to the home screen and opens it from there. In a normal Safari tab on iPhone the prompt is not shown.

title: Mobile app SDK for iOS and Android
text: Create a Firebase project, download the service account JSON file and upload it in Settings > Channels > Android. Then add the NotifyHub Android library to your app and call NotifyHub.init with your app ID.

title: Mobile app SDK for iOS and Android
text: In your Apple developer account create an APNs authentication key (.p8 file). In Settings > Channels > iOS upload the .p8 file and enter your Team ID, Key ID and bundle ID. Then add the NotifyHub iOS library and request notification permission in your app.

title: Mobile app SDK for iOS and Android
text: Push notifications cannot be tested on the iOS Simulator for production builds. Use a real device and send a test message from Campaigns > Test send to that device's subscriber ID.

title: Creating segments
text: NotifyHub has two segment types. Dynamic segments use rules and are recalculated every 15 minutes, so new subscribers join them automatically. Static segments are a fixed list that you upload as a CSV file with up to 500,000 subscriber IDs.

title: Creating segments
text: A dynamic segment can combine conditions on tags, custom attributes, country, browser, device type and the date of the last visit. Use AND to require all conditions or OR to require at least one.

title: Creating segments
text: The Growth plan allows up to 100 segments. The Business and Enterprise plans allow up to 500 segments. A segment with no subscribers still counts towards the limit until you delete it.

title: Tags and custom attributes
text: Tags are short labels on a subscriber, for example plan:pro or interest:shoes. Add them from your website with notifyhub.tag('plan', 'pro') or in bulk by uploading a CSV file in Audience > Import.

title: Tags and custom attributes
text: Each subscriber can have up to 50 custom attributes. Attribute names can be up to 64 characters and values up to 255 characters. Dates must use the format YYYY-MM-DD so they can be used in automations.

title: Tags and custom attributes
text: Remove a tag from one subscriber with notifyhub.untag('plan'). To remove a tag from everyone, open Audience > Tags and choose Delete tag. Deleting a tag also removes it from all segment rules that use it.

title: Automations
text: An automation starts when a subscriber does something or meets a condition: a new subscription, a tag being added, a custom event from your website, or a date attribute such as a birthday or a renewal date.

title: Automations
text: Add delay steps between messages, from 5 minutes to 30 days. Quiet hours are on by default from 22:00 to 08:00 in the subscriber's local time. A message that falls inside quiet hours waits and is sent at 08:00.

title: Automations
text: Each automation can have an exit condition. A subscriber who meets it leaves the automation and gets no more of its messages. Re-entry is off by default, so a subscriber goes through the same automation only once unless you turn re-entry on.

title: Abandoned cart automation
text: The abandoned cart template uses two events from your store: cart_updated when a product is added and order_completed when the order is paid. Send them with notifyhub.event('cart_updated', {value: 59.90}).

title: Abandoned cart automation
text: We recommend the first reminder 1 hour after the last cart_updated event and a second reminder after 24 hours. More than two reminders usually leads to more unsubscribes.

title: Abandoned cart automation
text: If subscribers keep getting reminders after they buy, your store is not sending the order_completed event. Check Settings > Events > Event log to see which events arrived in the last 24 hours.

title: Campaign reports
text: Delivered is the number of notifications accepted by the browser or device. Clicked is the number of clicks on the notification. CTR (click-through rate) is clicks divided by delivered notifications, shown as a percentage.

title: Campaign reports
text: Campaign reports update every 5 minutes. Final numbers are available 72 hours after sending, because devices that are offline can still receive the notification during that time.

title: Campaign reports
text: Open Reports > Export to download campaign results as a CSV file. Exports cover up to the last 13 months.

title: Conversion tracking and attribution
text: Send a purchase event with the order value: notifyhub.event('purchase', {value: 120, currency: 'EUR'}). Revenue appears in the campaign report under Conversions.

title: Conversion tracking and attribution
text: A purchase is attributed to a notification if it happens within 24 hours after a click. You can change the window to any value from 1 to 7 days in Settings > Attribution. Only clicks count; a notification that was shown but not clicked gets no credit.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Free: up to 2,000 subscribers. Growth: EUR 49 per month for up to 50,000 subscribers. Business: EUR 199 per month for up to 250,000 subscribers. Enterprise: custom price for larger lists, with a dedicated onboarding manager.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Your bill is based on active subscribers, counted on the first day of each month. A subscriber is active if their browser or device accepted at least one notification in the last 90 days.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Invoices are in Settings > Billing and are sent to the billing email on file. Monthly plans are paid by card. Annual Business and Enterprise plans can also be paid by bank transfer.

title: Changing or cancelling your plan
text: An upgrade takes effect immediately. You pay only the prorated difference for the rest of the current billing period.

title: Changing or cancelling your plan
text: A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing period. If you have more segments or subscribers than the new plan allows, sending is paused until you are under the limit.

title: Changing or cancelling your plan
text: You can cancel in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. After cancelling, your account data is kept for 30 days and then deleted permanently. Export your reports and subscriber list before the 30 days end.

title: Troubleshooting: notifications not delivered
text: Search for the subscriber in Audience > Subscribers and open the Delivery tab. It shows each notification and whether the browser or device accepted it.

title: Troubleshooting: notifications not delivered
text: Browsers can expire a subscription, for example after the user clears site data. NotifyHub removes a subscriber automatically after 3 failed delivery attempts in a row, so expired subscriptions do not count towards your bill.

title: Troubleshooting: notifications not delivered
text: Each notification has a time to live of 72 hours by default. If the device stays offline longer than that, the notification is dropped. Use a shorter time to live for flash sales.

title: Troubleshooting: notifications not delivered
text: Focus or do-not-disturb modes and blocked notifications in the operating system stop notifications from being shown, even when delivery succeeds. Ask the user to check the system notification settings for their browser.

title: Troubleshooting: the prompt does not appear
text: If a visitor clicked Block on the native browser prompt, the browser will not show it again. NotifyHub cannot reset this; the visitor has to allow notifications in the browser's site settings.

title: Troubleshooting: the prompt does not appear
text: Chrome may show a small bell icon in the address bar instead of the full prompt on sites where many visitors blocked notifications. Using the soft prompt first lowers the block rate and helps avoid this.

title: Troubleshooting: the prompt does not appear
text: Open the browser console on your site. If you see an error that nh-sw.js was not found, the service worker file is missing from the root folder of your domain.

title: Team access and security
text: NotifyHub has four roles. Owner manages billing and can delete the account. Admin manages settings and users. Editor creates and sends campaigns. Viewer can only see reports.

title: Team access and security
text: Only an Owner or an Admin can invite new users, in Settings > Team > Invite. The invitation link is valid for 7 days.

title: Team access and security
text: Owners can require two-factor authentication for every user in Settings > Security. Users without it set up are asked to configure it at their next sign-in.

title: Team access and security
text: Create API keys in Settings > API. A key is shown only once, so store it in a password manager. Delete and replace a key straight away if it may have been exposed.
